defects.problem: Every pick is resolved with solidcraft topology from the native CLI and an EMULATED pick-hit (lib.mjs pickEmu), never the page's real nearest_face on the display mesh in a browser; the rows state this caveat but keep status 'supported' and pageStatus 'supported'. Also the native solidcraft-cli the harness needs is not in the prepared rig (HOME cache path missing); it had to be built locally (-j1, 3m45s) to replay.

Supported evidence quotes r=4 = wall height: face count drops 12 -> 11 (wall face vanishes, degenerate), only a closed form agrees, OCCT and brep-rs both refuse; row 41 treats the same equality as degenerate and excludes it. Page builds it silently; the 'too large' refusal only starts above 4.
Text says 'round inside the limit 23 EXACT'; r3b replay and r3-results/r3b-size-sweep.txt give round EXACT 29 (bevel 23).
Status 'supported' for a partial build (1 of 4 rim edges rounded, rest refused with jargon cascade text); correct but easy to misread as the whole feature.
